display_name: PMIC Pharma Safety and Approval Signals
description: Scored drug-market and company safety briefs from openFDA: recalls (all and Class I), adverse event reports, label changes, and NDA/BLA and generic approvals for the US drug market, plus per-company recalls, adverse event reports, approvals and label changes for Pfizer, Eli Lilly and Johnson & Johnson. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend, drivers, risk flags, confidence and openFDA citations.

verticals.title: US drug market safety and approvals
verticals.question: Are drug safety signals rising, and is the approval pipeline active?
verticals.note: Higher score means calmer safety signals than usual (fewer recalls and adverse event reports) and more approvals.

verticals.title: Company drug safety
verticals.question: Are safety signals rising for this drug maker, and what has the FDA reported lately?
verticals.note: Higher score means calmer than usual for this company: fewer recalls and adverse event reports, more approvals. Label changes are a watch item.
